title: Anticholinergics for Cervical Edema in Labor
official: Anticholinergics for Cervical Edema in Labor (ACCEL)
summary: The purpose of this study is to is to determine the clinical effectiveness of a single dose of intravenous (IV) medication for the prevention of labor arrest and cesarean delivery in primiparous women undergoing trial of labor.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Primiparous
* Viable single intrauterine pregnancy

  -≥ 34 weeks of gestation
* Ruptured membranes
* Category I tracing at time of inclusion
* Active phase of labor (\>=6 cm of cervix dilation)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Category II or III tracing
* Allergy to the study medication (IV Diphenhydramine)
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston

sites.f: The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
